cutoff.cargoDetail: The box has to be inside the terminal gate.
cutoff.documentationDetail: Shipping instructions and the draft bill of lading.
cutoff.lede: Counted back from departure. Miss one and the booking rolls to the next sailing, whatever the transit time says.
cutoff.title: Cut-offs
cutoff.vgmDetail: Verified gross mass, per SOLAS. No VGM, no load.
freetime.body: Demurrage and detention run on the local tariff at each end. Additional free time can be purchased with the booking, at a discount to the daily rate.
freetime.title: Free time is not in this quotation
incoterm.cfr.note: The seller pays origin and the sea leg. Destination charges sit with the buyer.
incoterm.cif.note: As CFR, with marine insurance added. Destination charges still sit with the buyer.
incoterm.dap.note: The seller carries it to the named place. Import duty and clearance remain the buyer's.
incoterm.ddp.note: The seller carries everything, duty included.
incoterm.exw.note: The buyer carries everything from the seller's door. Nothing on this quotation is the seller's cost.
incoterm.fob.note: The seller pays to get the box loaded. Ocean and destination sit with the buyer.
notes.excluded: Duty, taxes, inspection and cargo insurance are excluded.
notes.surcharge: Surcharges are quoted as of today and are re-priced at booking.
notes.title: Notes
notes.validity: Rates hold for {hours} hours from quotation.
quote.title: Quotation
